notes: Macro-average over answerable items with gold_chunk_ids. Rank is first occurrence of a chunk id. Hybrid list alternates vector id, graph id, vector id, graph id, and skips a chunk already used. Both lists are retrieved even when the router said graph. Vector depth is 10 so recall@10 can differ from recall@5. The answer model still caps the pack (graph facts 12, vector passages 5); this table is retrieve-only and does not apply that cap. OOS items are skipped.
